name: Context
description: Defines and provides context@1: persona file loading, preamble, context build, and the view_image, session_search, session_view and skill_read tools.

items.label: Compaction threshold
items.summary: Share of the model's context window that triggers trimming and compaction.

items.label: Persona byte cap
items.summary: Max bytes read per persona file. A project can set its own.

items.label: Name sessions automatically
items.summary: After a session's first reply, title it with the provider's Utility model (set in the provider's own settings).

items.label: Skills
items.summary: List skills (<workspace>/skills and ~/.valet/skills, SKILL.md files) in the preamble and offer skill_read. A project can turn them off.
